then.message: The import runs on; this page shows how far it is

actions.script: const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const current = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.ContactServices.get#ImportDraft').parameters({importId: importId}).call() || {} hasDraft = !!current.found if (!hasDraft) return draft = current.draft isDone = draft.status === 'done' && !!draft.result isRunning = draft.status === 'running' failedText = draft.status === 'failed' ? (draft.error || L('The import stopped')) : null ready = !!draft.options result = draft.result || {} failureRows = Array.from(result.failureList || []).map((failure) => ({rowNumber: failure.rowNumber, error: failure.error, valuesText: Object.values(failure.values || {}).filter((value) => value != null && String(value).trim()).slice(0, 4).join(', ')})) const options = draft.options || {} bookId = result.contactBookId || options.contactBookId || null const books = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.ContactBookServices.get#UserContactBooks').call()?.contactBookList || [] const book = bookId ? books.find((entry) => entry.contactBookId === bookId) : null bookName = book ? book.contactBookName : null planText = ec.resource.expand('${rows} rows of ${file} as ${kind}${book}, duplicates ${policy}.', '', {rows: draft.rowCount || 0, file: draft.fileName || '', kind: options.asPersonal === false ? L('directory contacts') : L('your personal contacts'), book: bookName ? ' ' + L('into') + ' ' + bookName : '', policy: {skip: L('skipped'), update: L('updated'), create: L('created anyway')}[options.duplicatePolicy || 'skip']}) const total = Number(result.rowCount || 0) const doneCount = Number(result.createdCount || 0) + Number(result.updatedCount || 0) + Number(result.skippedCount || 0) + Number(result.failedCount || 0) progressHtml = '<q-linear-progress size="10px" rounded class="q-my-sm" color="' + (Number(result.failedCount || 0) ? 'warning' : 'positive') + '" :value="' + (total ? Math.min(1, doneCount / total).toFixed(3) : '1') + '"></q-linear-progress>'

label.text: The import goes on if you leave this page; come back to the import's result here.
Each row is imported on its own: a row that fails is listed with its reason and the others are imported.
